story.title: Kremlin Adviser Warns of Potential Attacks on UK Drone Factories
story.summary: A Kremlin adviser has indicated that UK drone factories could be targeted by 'unknown sources' following the UK's decision to share missile blueprints with Ukraine. This move is perceived by Russia as a sign of direct military involvement in the ongoing conflict.

timeline_highlights.title: Trump Announces Deal for Hamas Disarmament and Israeli Withdrawal from Gaza
timeline_highlights.summary: President Trump has announced a deal for Hamas to completely disarm, which includes the gradual withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza. Hamas confirmed its agreement to the plan, stating it would hand over its weapons to a Palestinian governing committee. However, the implementation of this deal is contingent upon Israel fulfilling its commitments from a previous agreement.

timeline_highlights.title: Trial Begins for Tupac Shakur's Murder, Accused Claims Nephew Fired Fatal Shots
timeline_highlights.summary: The trial regarding the murder of rapper Tupac Shakur has commenced in Las Vegas, years after his death. Duane Davis, 63, is accused of orchestrating the drive-by shooting that killed Shakur in 1996. In a recorded police interview from 2008, Davis stated that his nephew, Orlando Anderson, fired the shots that killed the hip-hop star.

timeline_highlights.title: Casualties Rise After Russian Strike on Ukrainian Mall
timeline_highlights.summary: A Russian drone strike on a shopping mall in Ukraine resulted in 16 fatalities and injured at least 130 individuals, including children. Rescue efforts are ongoing, with four people still reported missing following the attack. Ukrainian leader Zelensky condemned the strike as 'despicable,' highlighting the escalation of the conflict as it approaches its fifth year.

event_overview.title: About Gaza Peace Deal
event_overview.subject: Gaza Peace Deal
event_overview.summary: The Gaza peace deal is the name used for a U.S.-backed roadmap to implement a broader Gaza ceasefire and post-conflict transition. It links the decommissioning of weapons held by Hamas and other armed factions to a phased Israeli withdrawal, temporary international stabilization measures, Palestinian civilian administration, and reconstruction; its implementation remained conditional on verification and further agreed timetables as of August 22, 2026.

facts.label: Public roadmap
facts.value: A text published on July 31, 2026 described the arrangement as “A Roadmap for Completing the Implementation of President Trump’s Comprehensive Peace Plan in Gaza,” framed alongside UN Security Council Resolution 2803 (2025).

facts.label: Geographic and policy scope
facts.value: The roadmap concerns the Gaza Strip and states goals including ending hostilities, restoring civilian life, enabling Palestinian governance, supporting recovery and reconstruction, and creating conditions for Palestinian self-determination and statehood.

facts.label: Civil administration
facts.value: The proposed transitional civilian authority is the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), which the roadmap assigns responsibility for public services and, ultimately, control and storage of weapons in Gaza.

facts.label: Security and verification structure
facts.value: The roadmap calls for an International Verification Committee established by the Board of Peace to certify compliance before advancing phases. It also envisages a temporary International Stabilization Force to monitor the ceasefire, support humanitarian deliveries, train Palestinian police, and separate Israeli forces from NCAG-controlled areas.

facts.label: Sequencing
facts.value: Under the published text, weapons, military sites, depots, and tunnels would be decommissioned through a gradual, verified process connected to phased Israeli withdrawal; the timetable and operating mechanisms were to be prepared after approval of the roadmap rather than fixed in the text itself.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers late-July through mid-August 2026 announcements, responses, and related military developments around this roadmap; it does not attempt to cover the full Gaza war, all prior ceasefire diplomacy, or every stage of implementation.

related_stories.title: US Treasury Secretary Initiates 'Operation Economic Outcast' to Target Iran
related_stories.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced 'Operation Economic Outcast' aimed at isolating Iran economically. He stated that any entity facilitating money laundering for Iran would be excluded from the US dollar system. Concurrently, the Iranian rial fell to a record low of approximately 2.02 million to the dollar, as Bessent warned of an impending 'economic D-Day' for Iran.

related_stories.title: Trump Administration Plans to Revoke Visas of Up to 200,000 Asylum Seekers
related_stories.summary: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing to revoke the visas of up to 200,000 foreigners who have applied for or are currently seeking asylum in the United States. This action could represent the largest mass visa revocation in U.S. history, targeting individuals who entered the country on tourist or business visas.

related_stories.title: China Vows to Safeguard Interests Amid US Sanctions on Iran
related_stories.summary: China has condemned the US for threatening sanctions against nations that continue to engage in trade with Iran. Beijing stated it would take 'all necessary measures' to protect its interests, particularly in light of its significant oil imports from Tehran. The Chinese government characterized the US sanctions as illegal and expressed its commitment to maintaining its trade relations with Iran.
